effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Light Fang] trait and 1 card with the [Night Claw] or [Galaxy] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Light Fang]/[Night Claw] trait: Cost 2
